deficiencies.description: The rewrite states that the slice through a tumour 'illustrates this' (referring to biologists explanting the tumour), creating an unsourced link between the slice and explanting that the lecturer did not make.
deficiencies.sourcePassage: often they will explant the tumor. Here you're looking at a slice through a tumor and a stain to look at the morphology.
deficiencies.rewritePassage: A slice through a tumour, with a stain to show the morphology, illustrates this [FIGURE].

considerations.sourcePassage: Primary cells really don't grow in culture.
considerations.reason: The omission of 'really' ('Primary cells do not grow in culture') is an allowed stylistic removal of conversational emphasis rather than the removal of a scientific hedge.

considerations.sourcePassage: Whoops, I forgot to start my clock. Okay.
considerations.reason: This is a remark to the audience and self-correction during lecturing, which is allowed to be omitted.
